newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatargas first production train on stream..
newsitem.headline: Qatargas first production train on stream..

text.p: The first production train has come on stream at Qatar Liquefied Natural Gas Company's (Qatargas), liquefied natural gas (LNG) plant at Ras Laffan, a Qatari energy source said on Sunday.
The first production train at Qatargas -- Qatar's first LNG project -- has a capacity to produce two million tonnes a year of Qatari LNG which will allow gas exports to Japan from December.
Qatargas is 65 percent owned by the Qatar government, 10 percent each by U.S. Mobil Corp and France's Total SA and 7.5 percent each by Japan's Mitsui and Co Ltd and Marubeni Corp.
The project will produce four million tonnes a year of LNG from 1996 and an additional two million tonnes from 1998.
Chubu Electric Power Co and seven other Japanese firms will lift the gas from the Qatargas project.
